proof.command: Minted the cookie for someone@example.com with my own DISPATCH_SIGNING_KEY through a throwaway cmd/zzt3cookie calling auth.IssueSessionCookie (deleted after the run); seeded insert into people (email) and insert into user_sessions (login) (select login, generation → someone@example.com|0); booted the binary on 18800 under env -i with that signing key, DISPATCH_INSECURE_COOKIE=1 and no DISPATCH_SIGNIN_* at all; then, with that cookie and no bearer, GET /api/v1/whoami, GET /api/v1/inbox and POST /api/v1/me/agent-tokens with the matching Origin.
proof.observed: All three answer HTTP/1.1 401 {"code":"NO_IDENTITY","error":"unauthorized"}. The agent-token API is unaffected on the same server: GET /api/v1/whoami with the token 200 {"kind":"agent",...}, POST /api/v1/projects 201, /healthz "signin":null, GET /auth/start and GET /auth/callback both 503 SIGNIN_UNCONFIGURED.
